claims: The Artemis II crew and the Orion spacecraft safely returned to Earth on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew and the Orion spacecraft completed a successful splashdown in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California, at 8:07 p.m. EDT (5:07 p.m. PDT).
The splashdown wrapped up a 10-day mission around the Moon.
The splashdown marked the end of a ~695,000-mile journey.
Astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen were safely extracted from the capsule by recovery teams from the USS John P. Murtha.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon in over 50 years.
